node.title: XR collapsed minimum-face trades violate the post-strip core cap
node.statement: In the uniform high-core split-pencil cell at affine kernel rank a, the collapsed branch of a minimum-union rank-two trade is impossible. Its degree-<a interpolants on the active union X force every selected kernel codeword to extend from its a+1-point facet to all a+2 points of X. Any two active selected errors would then share P_0 union X, of size (k-a)+(a+2)=k+2, contradicting the proved post-strip distinct-slope common-zero cap k. Thus minimum-union rank-two trades consist only of the regular Plucker face syzygies; after quotienting those, every surviving rank-two trade has active union at least a+3. Larger-union rank-two trades, trade rank at least three, and the aggregate XR slope payment remain open.
